prompt: The reconnect test fails about one run in five on CI. Find out why and fix it.

content.text: I'll find where the reconnect backoff is scheduled and run the test a few times to catch the race.

reconnect.test.ts:
(pass) reconnects after a drop [304ms]
(fail) reconnects after a drop [301ms]
  expect(received).toBe(expected)
  Expected: 2
  Received: 3

 8 pass
 2 fail

Two problems. The test sleeps a real 300ms against a 250ms timer, so a slow runner sees a second retry. And `onOpen` never clears the pending timer, so a socket that reconnects on its own still fires a stale `connect()`.
